ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white clusters are concentrated at the terminal tips of both lobes and in a central vertical band flanking the median notch. The interior lobe areas consist of broad, contiguous low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 55 degrees; apex depth is significant, dividing the lobes prominently.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Notable large-amplitude indentations and 'bites' are visible on the inner trailing margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex curvature from the median notch to the tips, characterized by a jagged, non-linear progression due to high-frequency edge variations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-intensity white pixel groups are present at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple fine, high-contrast white linear marks (scratches) are visible against the dark pigmentation, primarily in the central-left and central-right regions of the lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and ragged indentations along the inner trailing edges of both lobes suggest historical physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white vertical patch extends from the median notch down the visible section of the peduncle.
